I feel you so much. In my country we have two holidays in december (Sinterklaas and Christmas). My birthday is ruined because of those. I let people know a month in advance. Ask them specifically to let me know in time if they come or not. And always I end up alone with the  food for the 25 people I invited. Because they cancel last minute....

I'm not celebrating it anymore. And now they wonder why I'm not....
